status_provenance_policy: reported_complete and running_as_last_reported are user observations, not live server verification. expected_server_records are absent artifacts to collect, not archived evidence.

timing_policy.started_at: Actual launch time when directly evidenced; otherwise date/minute precision is stated explicitly.
timing_policy.completed_at: Actual successful completion time when directly evidenced; otherwise null or a confirmed-complete-by time is used.
timing_policy.recorded_at: Time/date when the experiment record was written to Git history.
timing_policy.time_source: Direct source for the timing claim, such as process start display, queue log, experiment log, or retained artifact.
timing_policy.historical_rule: Do not invent missing historical clock times.

experiments.name: historical_modality_quality_reliability_diagnostics
experiments.purpose: Test whether the historical reliability gate behaves like a stable modality-quality estimator under Optical/DSM corruption.
experiments.result_summary: Historical gate response was not reliably aligned with modality degradation.
experiments.decision: Use as motivation only; do not resume the legacy reliability-v2 route unless later gates justify it.

experiments.name: grid_gsd_same_step_pp4k_ph4k
experiments.purpose: Compare PP4k and PH4k under jointly resampled raster grids while matching checkpoint step.
experiments.decision: Historical positive PH margin is not sufficient to claim a physical-GSD mechanism.

experiments.name: fixed_grid_information_degradation
experiments.purpose: Separate generic information/detail loss from historical Grid-GSD changes while keeping labels and output coordinates on the native grid.
experiments.result_summary: Joint x2 and DSM-only x2 did not show a PH-specific robustness advantage.
experiments.decision: Stop E51-C factor expansion; physical-frequency work is secondary unless PH-correct beats PH-shuffled under new training.

experiments.name: potsdam_train16_val2_test6_separation
experiments.purpose: Prevent the repeatedly exposed Potsdam TEST6 from influencing checkpoint or training-budget selection.
experiments.decision: Use Train16 for training and Val2 for development selection; do not load historical TEST6 during training.

experiments.name: r02_trainer_validation_checkpoint_smoke_gates
experiments.purpose: Verify the unified trainer, split isolation, deterministic short-run behavior, Val2 evaluation, and checkpoint path before a real budget pilot.
experiments.decision: Proceed to the first complete-schedule R02 budget pilot.

experiments.name: r02_complete_schedule_budget_pilot_12k
experiments.purpose: Determine whether a complete 12k LR schedule is sufficient before formal R01-R04 comparisons.
experiments.time_precision: started_at minute precision; exact completed_at not retained
experiments.time_source: process start display and corrected diagnostics queue
experiments.decision: Do not freeze 12k because the best validation score occurs at the schedule endpoint; run a fresh complete 16k pilot.

experiments.name: r02_val2_corruption_screen_12k_best
experiments.purpose: Measure absolute R02 sensitivity to mild modality degradation and artificial full-modality missing before a true Optical-only control exists.
experiments.decision: Sensitivity evidence only; matched R01 was subsequently completed in the core matrix.

experiments.name: resume_exactness_40_vs_20_save_restore_20
experiments.purpose: Verify exact deterministic equivalence of uninterrupted training and save/load plus RNG restoration.
experiments.decision: Accept the current deterministic resume path for REBUILD_V1 engineering use.

experiments.name: r02_complete_schedule_budget_pilot_16k
experiments.purpose: Test whether extending the complete LR decay horizon from 12k to 16k removes the endpoint-improvement ambiguity and provide the canonical matched clean dual baseline.
experiments.time_precision: started_at minute precision; exact completed_at not retained
experiments.time_source: process start display and post-run server inspection
experiments.decision: Freeze 16k and reuse this deterministic completed run as the canonical R02 clean baseline rather than duplicating an identical seed42 rerun.

experiments.name: true_optical_only_baseline
experiments.purpose: Train a genuine Optical-only baseline and establish matched system-level Fusion Gain and compute reference.
experiments.decision: Use as the matched true Optical-only comparator for clean and DSM-degradation Fusion Gain.

experiments.name: matched_dsm_severity_fusion_gain
experiments.purpose: Test whether positive clean dual-modal gain becomes negative as DSM information is progressively degraded while Optical remains unchanged.
experiments.decision: G1 conditional/harmful fusion is supported on development Val2: clean gain is positive and down8 makes matched NB Fusion Gain negative.

experiments.name: dual_modality_dropout_training
experiments.purpose: Test how much missing-modality robustness is solved by a simple modality-dropout baseline.
experiments.decision: Strong simple missing-modality baseline: most catastrophic DSM-zero failure is repaired, but a residual fallback gap remains relative to true Optical-only.

experiments.name: dual_quality_corruption_training
experiments.purpose: Test how much degraded-modality robustness is solved by ordinary quality-corruption training.
experiments.decision: Strong baseline for clean and mild/moderate degradation, but does not solve severe or missing DSM and performs very poorly under DSM zero.

experiments.name: r01_r02_r03_r04_unified_core_matrix
experiments.purpose: Unify clean, degraded-DSM, robustness and Fusion-Gain evidence before selecting the next method-development route.
experiments.decision: Next priority is an Optical+Optical dual-stream capacity control, followed by selective/reliability-aware DSM or lightweight DSM only if the corresponding evidence remains after capacity and compute controls.

experiments.name: dual_optical_gray_capacity_control
experiments.purpose: Separate dual-stream capacity effects from DSM-specific information.
experiments.decision: C-OO exceeds R02 clean on Val2; do not attribute the full R02-R01 gain to DSM-specific information.

experiments.name: dual_dsm_quality_plus_dropout
experiments.purpose: Test the combined ordinary quality-corruption and modality-dropout baseline.
experiments.decision: Strong current robustness baseline, but complete DSM absence remains below true Optical-only R01.

experiments.name: dual_optical_gray_quality_plus_dropout_control
experiments.purpose: Provide a capacity and augmentation matched control for R05 without DSM values.
experiments.decision: Use as the matched second-stream capacity and Q+D control for R05.

experiments.name: local_failure_diagnostics
experiments.purpose: Measure local missing-input, spatial-misalignment and local-quality sensitivity.
experiments.decision: Local missing needs Optical fallback; local down8 retains DSM value at seed42; shifts are monotonic but modest.

experiments.name: frozen_expert_routing_diagnostics
experiments.purpose: Test frozen-expert complementarity, nonlearned routing and variable-shape mask generalization.
experiments.decision: SafeMaxConfidence passed the tested candidates; same-fallback average/entropy controls remain missing. B1 is a running compression pilot, not a completed method.

experiments.name: dropout_ablations_and_seed17_replications
experiments.decision: Archive existing A1/A2 and R01/R05/C-OO-QD seed17 outputs rather than rerunning.

experiments.name: single_student_safe_router_distillation_pilot
experiments.final_conclusion: At seed42, KD exceeded the matched CE continuation on clean, global DSM down8 and global DSM zero. SAFE did not consistently improve on KD.
experiments.purpose: Compare matched CE continuation, safe-teacher KD and KD with an explicit Optical fallback constraint.
experiments.decision: Continue KD as the primary reliability-teacher arm. Do not continue SAFE without new evidence.

experiments.name: teacher_target_control_queue
experiments.purpose: Separate reliability-aware teacher-target selection from generic R05-teacher distillation and simple probability averaging.
experiments.decision: KD is lower than R05_KD on clean but higher under down8 and zero. AVG_KD has no consistent advantage. Proceed to paired diagnostics and independent-seed replication.

experiments.name: paired_local_degradation_diagnostic
experiments.purpose: Compare corrupt-minus-clean performance on identical damaged and boundary pixels to distinguish damage sensitivity from intrinsic regional difficulty.
experiments.decision: Reliability-aware KD consistently degrades less than ordinary R05-teacher KD within seed42, but absolute gains over CE are mixed for local missing boundaries. Boundary is secondary; replicate seed17.

experiments.name: seed17_reliability_teacher_replication
experiments.purpose: Replicate the seed42 distinction among CE continuation, generic R05-teacher distillation and SafeMaxConfidence teacher-target selection.
experiments.time_source: validated queue status and per-run summaries supplied from the experiment server
experiments.provenance_note: The trainers reported Git HEAD abb3d97 while later B4 files were selectively installed. Server preflight source hashes are authoritative for executed source identity.
experiments.decision: Global down8/zero ordering over R05_KD repeats, but both paired local damaged-region directions reverse. Close the current SafeMaxConfidence distillation route as the proposed main method; retain B1-B4 as mechanism, ablation and negative-result evidence.

experiments.name: data_sampling_scale_semantic_boundary_audit
experiments.purpose: Determine whether class imbalance, random-crop exposure, connected-object size, semantic boundaries, or class-specific DSM degradation justify a controlled training intervention.
experiments.decision: The completed audit supports a matched small-Car sampling screen, not a generic long-tail or weighted-loss claim. See docs/experiments/D7_RESULTS_20260922.md.

experiments.name: small_car_sampling_screen
experiments.purpose: Isolate the effect of any-Car and small-Car crop selection with the same R01 initialization, CE loss and 4000-step budget.
experiments.decision: Neither A nor S passes the frozen conjunctive gate. Do not run D8 seed17 or relax the thresholds. Retain size-specific sampling as exploratory heterogeneity evidence.

experiments.name: frozen_expert_dsm_marginal_benefit_diagnostic
experiments.purpose: Test whether observable semantic, frequency and expert-disagreement features predict the label-defined marginal benefit and harm from DSM.
experiments.decision: D9A is complete: entropy difference beats confidence on benefit ranking in all 16 comparisons, while tested disagreement interactions lose. Fitted semantic/frequency combinations and safety-gate training require a new frozen evaluation source.

experiments.name: frozen_expert_direct_benefit_score_audit
experiments.time_source: user-supplied queue status and successful server summarizer output
experiments.purpose: Measure label-defined DSM benefit and compare unfitted confidence, entropy and expert-disagreement scores across two seeds and eight conditions.
experiments.decision: Close the tested disagreement interactions as improvements over confidence. Entropy ranks benefit better overall and in Car/damaged strata, but routing utility is unverified. The local-down8 D5 routing has been corrected in D9A_LOCAL_DOWN8_ROUTING_FIX1; the original two D5 values remain invalid. Locate original D5 metrics before any separate entropy-route evaluation; do not train a safety gate from D9A.

experiments.name: correct_local_down8_known_missing_fallback
experiments.time_source: user-supplied queue status and successful server summarizer output
experiments.purpose: Correct only the D5 routing result and selected-dual harm when local DSM is downsampled but still available.
experiments.reason_for_rerun: The original D9A route treated the damaged-region mask as a DSM-absence mask and forced RGB in local down8.
experiments.decision: Corrected local-down8 D5 mIoU exceeds both frozen experts at both seeds, while selected-dual harm remains nonzero. Original local-down8 D5 routing values are invalid; no D9 safety-gate claim follows.

experiments.name: independent_scene_source_audit
experiments.purpose: Identify a spatially independent labelled optical+DSM source before fitting or evaluating D9 benefit predictors.
experiments.result_summary: Known Potsdam Train16/Val2/Test6 scenes and historical Vaihingen train12/test4 scenes are exposed; no documented untouched scene source is presently available.
experiments.decision: Do not fit or claim independent confirmation for D9B until additional labelled optical+DSM scenes and prior exposure are audited and partitions frozen.

experiments.name: matched_safe_entropy_vs_safe_confidence_decision_audit
experiments.time_source: user-supplied queue start and successful server summarizer output
experiments.purpose: Test whether D9A entropy benefit-ranking gains improve actual routed mIoU and selected-dual CE harm without retraining either expert.
experiments.reason_for_new_evaluation: Original D5 seed42/17 logs report completion, but their per-seed metric directories are absent from project records; D9A did not compute entropy-route mIoU.
experiments.decision: D9A evidence extraction is closed. Better CE-benefit ranking did not make safe-entropy routing outperform safe confidence; Car and Building IoU move in opposite directions, and local-down8 damage results reverse across seeds. Move to the D9B decision-relevant benefit screen; fitted combinations remain gated on an independent source.

experiments.name: expert_disagreement_conditioned_dsm_benefit_screen
experiments.purpose: Compare observable semantic, frequency and expert features on decisions where selecting R05 can change the predicted label.
experiments.primary_target: dual_only_correct versus rgb_only_correct on expert-disagreement pixels, with both-wrong and CE benefit reported separately
experiments.fitting_policy: unfitted Val2 screen only until an independent spatially disjoint labelled source is frozen
experiments.decision: The fixed input-space semantic/frequency/expert combination fails the cross-seed decision-benefit gate; close this exact Val2 screen. Do not train a safety residual gate or fit/calibrate a selector until an independent spatially disjoint labelled source is frozen.

experiments.name: amplitude_preserving_shift_and_harm_rescue
experiments.purpose: Run the previously proposed spatial-correspondence mechanism experiment using frozen R01/R05; no new data prerequisite.
experiments.decision: Close fixed structure scoring: primary harm-rescue comparison fails and shift mIoU direction reverses across seeds. No rerun, weight/radius search, or residual-gate training. Learned benefit prediction remains a separate untested hypothesis.

experiments.name: linear_decision_benefit_probe_with_off_val2_calibration
experiments.purpose: Establish supervised benefit predictability from frozen expert outputs and screen incremental frequency inputs; not residual-gate training.
experiments.expert_training_exposure: All head-development tiles were seen by the frozen experts; repeatedly used Val2 is exploratory evaluation only.
experiments.decision: Close the frozen linear probe under the predeclared screen. No full-resolution candidate or residual gate. Deep decoder context remains untested.

experiments.name: frozen_decoder_context_frequency_capacity_screen
experiments.purpose: Compare deep decoder context, frequency, and capacity using matched frozen experts.
experiments.decision: Close the exact D12 frozen-expert screen. No two-seed candidate, full-image confirmation or residual gate. Do not use pooled shuffled-control attribution until the run revision is checked against the d28e4af correction.

experiments.name: staged_rgb_anchored_dsm_residual_negative_transfer_pilot
experiments.purpose: Test whether a trainable DSM residual and a harm-aware training surrogate reduce new errors while preserving correction gains relative to frozen R01.
experiments.stage2_policy: Only if all Stage 1 pairs complete and DSM-risk passes all prespecified margins in both seeds
experiments.evaluation: Potsdam Val2 full images, exploratory because previously inspected
experiments.decision: Close this D13 Stage 1 design under its prespecified gate. Do not run Stage 2 or repeat the same Val2 screen. Paired source-file diagnosis found a small DSM increment reversing across seeds and suppression of both harm and rescue; any counterfactual DSM-use check needs a new inference-only protocol.

experiments.name: frozen_d13_dsm_content_decision_sensitivity
experiments.purpose: Test whether changing DSM content while keeping availability true changes predictions of frozen D13 Stage 1 heads.
experiments.evaluation: Potsdam Val2 full images, diagnostic only
experiments.decision: Source-file audit completed without discrepancy. DSM heads have nonzero decision-level sensitivity to DSM content and RGB controls are invariant, but mIoU changes are mixed and D13's gain/rescue gate remains failed. Do not rerun this Val2 diagnostic or reopen D13 Stage 2.

experiments.name: DSM_only_baseline_and_paired_RGB_degradation
experiments.purpose: Measure DSM-only capability under the matched R01 schedule and whether R05 gains over RGB and matched-capacity controls when RGB detail degrades.
experiments.training: two DSM-only 16k jobs; existing experts inference-only
experiments.decision: Await both-seed capability and RGB degradation evidence before choosing a new method; no new method training is auto-launched.

experiments.name: risk_controlled_decision_benefit_selector
experiments.purpose: Test a learned decision-relevant DSM benefit predictor and calibrated abstention after accepting a new independent image-height segmentation source.
experiments.decision: No D10 fitting or GPU queue until source access, prior exposure, scene-disjoint expert/head/calibration/evaluation partitions, class mapping, and dataset-specific thresholds are frozen.

duplicate_policy.rule: Do not repeat a completed or closed fingerprint.

execution_boundaries.d15_exception: User authorized physical GPU0 and GPU1 for D15. Its new queue applies an explicit dual-worker device check; this older GPU0-only machine policy and validator remain for historical queues.
